column1: # The messages shown when a rule fires, in English. Columns: id, status, en, reason. The id is a rule's
# message name (SEIMHIU); names joined by = share one message (CUPLA=KESUNYANS).
#   inherited   from An Gramadóir 0.70 (share/messages.bs), unchanged; the build checks that
#               it still matches upstream word for word
#   unreviewed  written or changed by Claude, not yet approved by Liam
#   reviewed    approved by Liam (inherited or written by Claude)
# To improve an inherited message, change its text and mark it unreviewed until Liam approves it.
# In the text, /like this/ (or \/like this\/) marks Irish words; \/\1\/ is the word the rule
# supplies. reason (optional): the id of a row in grammar/reasons.tsv, shown with the message when
# its rule names no reason of its own. Latin-1 only. One line per message; tabs between columns.
